company.text: US Tool Group supplies **cutting tools and tool services** (regrinding, reconditioning) to manufacturers, mainly in aerospace, defense and metalworking. Founded in 1958 by Paul G. Williams, it is still **family-owned** with third-generation leadership, headquartered in Farmington, Missouri, with operations in Canada and Mexico.

financials.text: Private: third-party estimates put revenue around **$100M-$400M** (wide range, to be confirmed). No outside funding.
